intro: The active participle of the past characterizes the agent by an earlier action: прочитавший, приехавшая, построившие.

bloques.titulo: The active participle of the past characterizes the agent by an earlier action: прочитавший, приехавшая, построившие.
texto: The active participle of the past characterizes the agent by an earlier action: прочитавший, приехавшая, построившие.
Concords with the noun in gender and number, and retains supplements of the verb from which it comes.

frases.ru: Автор, написавший статью, ответил на вопросы.
frases.es: El autor que escribió el artículo respondió a las preguntas.
frases.en: The author who wrote the article responded to the questions.

frases.ru: Мы встретили туристов, приехавших из Казани.
frases.es: Nos encontramos con unos turistas que habían llegado de Kazán.
frases.en: We met some tourists who had arrived from Kazan.

bloques.pregunta: What form is consistent with туристов?

opciones.explicacion: Туристов is masculine animated in plural; the participle also goes in plural.
This form does not express the relationship that the question calls for.
Check which word rules the case or the structure.

opciones.texto: The author who wrote the article responded to the questions.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: We met some tourists who had arrived from Kazan.
opciones.explicacion: That's the translation of the second example.

bloques.frase: Мы встретили туристов, приехавших из Казани
